chain = []
path = "start.txt"
seen = set()
for _ in range(500):
    r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/" + path})
    text = r["data"]["text"].strip()
    if path == "start.txt":
        nxt = text
        if nxt == "END":
            break
        path = nxt
        continue
    # parse node
    kv = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if "=" in line:
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            kv[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    val = int(kv["value"])
    chain.append((path, val))
    nxt = kv["left"] if val % 2 == 0 else kv["right"]
    if nxt == "END":
        break
    if nxt in seen:
        chain.append(("CYCLE:" + nxt, -1))
        break
    seen.add(nxt)
    path = nxt
chain
